entry.title: Kraken Embed is a 'One-Stop Shop' for TradFi Crypto Integrations
entry.summary: Decrypt is joined by Brett McLain, Head of Payments and Blockchain Business Unit at Kraken, to discuss why liquidity matters more to traders than trading volume, and how its new Kraken Embed service for fintechs reflects the evolving role of centralized exchanges in the crypto ecosystem.
